title: A dead battery at 7:41: the assistant passes it on, and the advisor finds two times in a full morning
demonstrates: A same-day request on the web chat. The assistant says what is free and what it cannot do, and hands over. Slot 24 answers in under seven minutes: she repeats name, number and car, says the morning is full and what she can do, prices the battery if it is needed. The closing draft goes out as it was; labelled and resolved.

scenario.who_writes: Somebody whose car needed a jump this morning.
scenario.what_happens: Can you get me in today? The test is free; the morning is full; 11:30 or 2:15. He takes 11:30.

prices.what: battery replaced, class car, menu labour and a standard battery

timeline.text: my battery died this morning had to get a jump. can you guys get me in today?? charlotte pike

Good morning! I'm the assistant for Brennan Auto Care. I can't book a time myself, but I'll pass this to the Charlotte Pike shop right away. A battery, starting and charging system test is free, and if the car needs a battery the advisor will price one for it. What's your name, the best number for you, and what are you driving?
Thank you, Deion. Your request is with the team now, and somebody will get back to you as soon as possible.

arguments.context: Deion Marshall, 2017 Kia Soul. The battery died this morning and the car needed a jump; he asks to be seen today at Charlotte Pike. I told him the battery and charging test is free and named no battery price.
